steps.action: On existing F-host run docs/chatgpt_status/topography/shards/height_difference_2/automation/030_apply_attempt_020_existing_f_runner_recovery.ps1 only; preserve/start exactly one persistent canonical daemon and do not create a second runner.
Verify all four recovery/output receipts, persistent_daemon_count_after=1, fresh heartbeat and exact task/attempt/continuation claim before canonical numeric work.

Use the live Defra OGC Features service in native EPSG:27700 with an XML/JSON-capable runtime client; intersect each exact BNG target with National_LIDAR_Programme_Index_Catalogue and record only returned dtm_fn, tilename, flight dates, surveys, resolution, year and latest.

Intersect each exact BNG target with LIDAR_DTM_Time_Stamped_Extents; record only returned dtm_name, ostilename, flight dates, resolution, transform, geoid and latest. Never infer lineage from a neighbouring feature.
Use current July 2026 HMLR INSPIRE GML and native BNG geometry for point-in-polygon validation. Do not reproject to web CRS for acceptance because HMLR documents possible reprojection shifts.
Use an XML-capable client on the documented persistent Composite DTM 1m WCS 2.0.1 endpoint; record the real CoverageId via GetCapabilities and DescribeCoverage before GetCoverage.
Retrieve actual EA DTM1m raster bytes for the bounded native HMLR polygons; exclude NoData and compute median, q1, q3, min and max only from real pixels inside each polygon.
Use current OS Terrain 50 July 2026 OpenData supply; require real download/archive bytes and observed TQ39/TQ59/TQ27 members before secondary pixel-centre crosschecks.

Run three EA/OS numeric crosschecks, retain EA DTM1m as primary, verify port 8012 and resolve the manual action only after all F-host receipts plus fresh heartbeat/claim and accepted outputs are remotely verified.
